mapper.insert: insert into media_episode(id, media_id, season_number, episode_number, air_date, isUpdate, create_date, update_date) values (#{item.id}, #{item.mediaId}, #{item.seasonNumber}, #{item.episodeNumber}, #{item.airDate}, #{item.isUpdate}, #{item.createDate}, #{item.updateDate})
mapper.select: select episode_number from media_episode where media_id = #{mediaId} and air_date <= #{airDate} and is_update = 0
